name: Nicky Boum
author: emu_kidid
description_long: Nicky Boum is a classic platformer game initially designed for the Amiga. The game was published by Microids in 1992 and was also ported to the Atari ST and PC EGA platforms.

license.notes: Repository ships no LICENSE file. Engine derived from a third-party reverse-engineering project (cyxdown.free.fr/nicky); original Nicky Boum game data is copyrighted by Microids and must be supplied by the user.
